dog.description_text:
Chicken Noodle is a 3-year-old bulldog mix who weighs around 47 lbs, and he is one seriously easygoing guy. He’s extremely friendly, gentle, and just as happy curling up for a cuddle as he is entertaining himself with a toy.

He’s crate-trained, laid-back, and has that kind of personality that makes him very easy to have around. Chicken Noodle is affectionate without being demanding, playful without being over the top, and overall just a really good boy.

Registered adopters interested in Chicken Noodle can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
